# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes ship in the latest release only, listed on the [Releases page](https://github.com/WhiteMuush/Gardik/releases). Upgrade to it to receive them.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Report them privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/WhiteMuush/Gardik/security/advisories/new).

Include:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact

You will receive a response within 72 hours. If confirmed, a patch will be released as soon as possible.
